metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Lake Sambhar, India decrease in around April 10, 2019 compared to around September 30, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Collection: MODIS Daily Surface Water (MODIS/006/MOD44W), 250m, Global. 2. April 10 2019 vs Sept 30 2018 (±15 days each). 3. Water mask already provided (band ‘water_mask’: 1 = water, 0/2 = land/cloud). 4. Compute sum of water pixels inside a ~30 km buffer around Lake Sambhar (26.9°N 75.2°E). 5. If either date has 0 images or 0 valid pixels after clipping, return C1/C2. 6. Compare total water pixels: if April 2019 < Sept 2018 → A (Yes), else B (No). 7. Scale 1000 m keeps request light. import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time loc = ee.Geometry.Point(75.2, 26.9) roi = loc.buffer(30000) # ~Lake area spring= ee.Date('2019-04-10').advance(-15,'day'), ee.Date('2019-04-10').advance(15,'day') autumn= ee.Date('2018-09-30').advance(-15,'day'), ee.Date('2018-09-30').advance(15,'day') # 2. Fetch collections sw = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD44W') \ .select('water_mask') \ .map(lambda img: img.clip(roi)) c1 = sw.filterDate(*spring) c2 = sw.filterDate(*autumn) if c1.size().getInfo()==0 or c2.size().getInfo()==0: print('C1: Empty Collection') print('C1') exit() # mosaic and water=1 w1 = c1.mosaic().eq(1) w2 = c2.mosaic().eq(1) # 3. Valid pixels check cnt1 = w1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water_mask').getInfo() cnt2 = w2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water_mask').getInfo() if cnt1==0 or cnt2==0: print('C2: No Valid Pixels') print('C2') exit() # 4. Water extent (sum of water pixels) sum1 = w1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water_mask').getInfo() sum2 = w2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water_mask').getInfo() print(f'Sept 2018 water pixels: {int(sum2)}') print(f'Apr 2019 water pixels: {int(sum1)}') # 5. Decision if sum1 is None or sum2 is None: print('C3') elif sum1 < sum2: print('A') else: print('B')
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
loc   = ee.Geometry.Point(75.2, 26.9)
roi   = loc.buffer(30000)  # ~Lake area
spring= ee.Date('2019-04-10').advance(-15,'day'), ee.Date('2019-04-10').advance(15,'day')
autumn= ee.Date('2018-09-30').advance(-15,'day'), ee.Date('2018-09-30').advance(15,'day')

# 2. Fetch collections
sw = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD44W') \
        .select('water_mask') \
        .map(lambda img: img.clip(roi))
c1 = sw.filterDate(*spring)
c2 = sw.filterDate(*autumn)
if c1.size().getInfo()==0 or c2.size().getInfo()==0:
    print('C1: Empty Collection')
    print('<answer>C1</answer>')
    exit()
# mosaic and water=1
w1 = c1.mosaic().eq(1)
w2 = c2.mosaic().eq(1)

# 3. Valid pixels check
cnt1 = w1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
       geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water_mask').getInfo()
cnt2 = w2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
       geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water_mask').getInfo()
if cnt1==0 or cnt2==0:
    print('C2: No Valid Pixels')
    print('<answer>C2</answer>')
    exit()

# 4. Water extent (sum of water pixels)
sum1 = w1.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
       geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water_mask').getInfo()
sum2 = w2.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
       geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water_mask').getInfo()
print(f'Sept 2018 water pixels: {int(sum2)}')
print(f'Apr 2019 water pixels:  {int(sum1)}')

# 5. Decision
if sum1 is None or sum2 is None:
    print('<answer>C3</answer>')
elif sum1 < sum2:
    print('<answer>A</answer>')
else:
    print('<answer>B</answer>')
